queryEn: Canada Visit Visa Requirments
answerEn:
Valid Passport – Your passport should be valid for the duration of your stay.
Visitor Visa (Temporary Resident Visa - TRV) – Required for many nationalities, including Pakistani citizens.
Completed Visa Application Form.
Recent Passport-Sized Photographs.
Proof of Financial Support – Bank statements, salary slips, or other evidence showing you can cover your expenses.
Travel Itinerary – Flight reservations and travel plans (if available).
Purpose of Visit – Invitation letter (if visiting family/friends) or details of tourism plans.
Proof of Ties to Home Country – Job letter, business documents, property documents, family ties, etc., showing you will return home.
Biometrics – Fingerprints and photograph at an approved visa application center.
Visa Fee and Biometrics Fee.
answerUr:
Visit Visa (TRV) – Pakistani citizens ko visit visa ki zaroorat hoti hai.
Visa Application Form mukammal tarah fill ki hui.
Recent Passport Size Photos.
Financial Proof – Bank statement, salary slips ya doosre saboot ke aap apne kharchay utha sakte hain.
Travel Plan – Flight booking ya travel itinerary (agar mojood ho).
Visit ka Maqsad – Family/friends ki invitation letter ya tourism plan.
Pakistan se Strong Ties ka Proof – Job letter, business documents, property papers, family responsibilities waghera.
Biometrics – Fingerprints aur photo deni hoti hai.
Visa aur Biometrics Fees jama karani hoti hain.

queryEn: What is Judicial Review (JR) for a Canada visa?

JR process mein kitna waqt lagta hai?
Is pure process mein aam tor par 4 se 8 mahine lagte hain, jo court ke schedule par depend karta hai.

queryEn: Should I reapply or go for JR?
answerEn: If refusal was due to weak documents, reapply. If your documents were perfect but the decision was unfair, JR is a strong option.
answerUr:
Mujhe dobara apply karna chahiye ya JR?
Agar documents weak the toh reapply karein. Agar documents perfect the aur faisla galat tha, toh JR behtar hai.
